notes.name: How the Okafors came to Lagos
notes.body: Mama Nnukwu left Nnewi in 1962, Daddy Chief started the first shop in Oshodi in 2002, the house in Ikeja in 2009.

notes.name: Names and their meanings
notes.body: Chiamaka means God is beautiful, Kelechi means thank God, Ifeanyi means nothing is impossible with God.

notes.name: Diary entry - rough week
notes.body: Truck broke down on the Third Mainland Bridge, WAEC nerves at home, Mama Nnukwu not eating well.

notes.name: Diary entry - good Sunday
notes.body: Church was full, Chiamaka finished her papers, jollof for dinner and Nkem danced with Daddy Chief.

notes.name: Vehicle details

notes.name: Allergy info
notes.body: Ifeanyi is allergic to shellfish, Nkem to eggs, epipen in the kitchen drawer.

notes.name: Generator oil schedule
notes.body: change oil every 200 hours, filters every 400, Engr Segun comes in March, June, September and December.

notes.name: Prayer points for the year
notes.body: Chiamaka's exams, the new warehouse, Daddy Chief's health, peace in the estate.
